name: Fathom Analytics
summary: Fathom Analytics is a privacy-first, paid website analytics tool that counts visitors and events without using cookies.

free_plan_covers.note: Fathom has no permanent free plan, only a 7-day free trial before billing starts.

first_paid_usd_month.note: The cheapest plan costs $15 a month billed monthly and covers up to 100,000 monthly page views, with custom events counted toward that limit.

portability.note: Fathom lets you export unlimited CSV data and pull data through its API, but the hosted product is closed source with no practical self-hosting option today.

cookies.note: Fathom does not use cookies or similar technology, so it needs no cookie consent banner.

product_events.note: Fathom can track custom events, like a purchase or button click, with the trackEvent() function, optionally attaching a value.

setup.step: Start a free trial at Fathom and create a site to get your Site ID.
Copy your site's embed code from the Fathom dashboard; it is one script tag that carries your Site ID.
Paste the script into the head of every page, usually in your app's shared layout or main HTML template.
In a single-page app, use your framework's Fathom integration or Fathom's SPA mode so page changes count as page views.

builder_notes: Fathom never sets cookies, so it needs no cookie consent banner.
Custom events count toward the plan's monthly page view limit, so only track actions that matter.
